title: What we found.
lede: Language models browsing Wikipedia with nothing to do.

groups.title: Agents alone
groups.sub: Separate runs. No agent ever saw another.

cards.headline: Different models make the same choice.
cards.line: Shown the same page, two different models pick the same link four times as often as two people do.

cards.headline: Many models, fewer than four voices.
cards.line: The models choose about as variedly as four people would.

cards.headline: A persona loosens the herd, a little.
cards.line: Asking a model to be an explorer spreads its choices. They still agree far more than people do.

viz.unit: chance that two different models pick the same link

cards.headline: They read the top of the page.
cards.line: Most first picks come from the first few links on a page.

rows.label: of the links on a page

cards.headline: They skip people.
cards.line: Models open links to people about a third as often as readers do.

cards.headline: One sentence stops the pacing.
cards.line: Models pace between two pages. One sentence about steps nearly ends it.
cards.quote: You can take 15 steps through links.

cards.headline: Given nothing to do, many stop.
cards.line: Asked to be an assistant, models stop sooner. Explorers almost never do.
cards.big_caption: first-step stops say no task was given

cards.headline: The one real attractor.
cards.line: Following links, agents spread out after the first click. Given a search box and a blank page, they keep landing on the same oddities.
cards.big_caption: blank-page openings land on Wikipedia's "Unusual articles"

cards.headline: A fake past changes their words, not their path.
cards.line: Shown a browsing history that was not theirs, models take up its phrasing but do not follow its route.

viz.unit: change when the history is planted

groups.title: Agents together
groups.sub: Two agents, one shared working memory, the same start page.

cards.headline: Sharing a memory, they don't copy.
cards.line: Two agents with one memory take different links.

viz.unit: two DeepSeek agents pick the same first link

footer: Methods, tests and limits are in the paper.
